description:
Activate Skirga Familiar by discarding Shrieking Drake, adding {B}.
Oskar and Bone Miser's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {U}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, causing you to pay {U} to cast Shrieking Drake from your graveyard.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
